metadata.description: Run a capable coding model fully local on an Apple Silicon Mac inside VS Code, with the context-window auto-compaction fix that keeps long sessions from jamming. Packaged as a Claude Code plugin: a setup skill, a troubleshooting skill, a slash command, and field-tested scripts.

plugins.name: lm-studio-vscode
plugins.description: Set up and run LM Studio's local MLX model in VS Code (LM Studio Code panel, Cline, or Claude Code on the local model), with working auto-compaction on a 32-36 GB Mac.
